name: JPARK Mactan International Marathon 2026
short_description: A multi-distance marathon event on Mactan Island, Lapu-Lapu City, Philippines, held October 11, 2026, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: The JPARK Mactan International Marathon 2026 takes place on October 11, 2026, on Mactan Island in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu, Philippines. Organized by the Bohol International Marathon organization in partnership with Jpark Island Resort, the event offers four distance options: full marathon (42.195km), half marathon (21.1km), 10km, and 5km. Registration is currently open for runners interested in participating.

core_facts.organizer: Bohol International Marathon org. with Jpark Island Resort

pros: Multiple distance options available: full marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 5km
Scenic venue on Mactan Island, Lapu-Lapu City
Backed by an experienced organizing body (Bohol International Marathon org.) with resort partnership
research_highlights: This is the first-ever Jpark Mactan International Marathon, organized in partnership with the established Bohol International Marathon organization — the race has no prior editions, so there are no participant race reports yet as of this writing.
The race offers four distance categories: 42K, 21K, 10K, and 5K, taking place on October 11, 2026 in Lapu-Lapu City, Mactan.

The 42K course includes timing points at KM5.95 (Be Resorts Mactan), KM14.35 (near former St. Augustine School, Gen. Aviation Rd.), and KM35.92 (Roro Port of Cordova), indicating the route runs out to Cordova and back.
Registration for the early bird rate opened February 7, 2026 and ran until March 7, 2026, with sign-ups handled via the event's Facebook page.

The organizer, Bohol International Marathon, has a track record from its own events — e.g., BIM 2025 became the first edition of that race to earn World Athletics accreditation, and past editions were noted for having a very high number of hydration stations (23) — though this is about the organizer's other event, not direct evidence about how the Mactan race itself will run.
research_watchouts: No independent participant reviews, race reports, or running-community discussion of the JPark Mactan International Marathon itself could be found — it is a brand-new event that has not yet taken place, so course conditions, crowd support, heat management, and on-the-ground organization are unverified by runners.
Most available coverage is promotional/organizational press (partnership announcements, resort marketing) rather than firsthand runner commentary.

faqs.question: When is the JPARK Mactan International Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The event is scheduled for October 11, 2026. It will be held on Mactan Island, in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu, Philippines. Runners interested in participating can register now, as registration for this event is currently open according to the available details.

faqs.question: What distance options are available at this race?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from four distances: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, or a 5km race. This range of options makes the event accessible to a variety of runners, from beginners to experienced marathoners.

faqs.question: Who organizes the JPARK Mactan International Marathon?
faqs.answer: The marathon is organized by the Bohol International Marathon organization in collaboration with Jpark Island Resort. This partnership brings together race-organizing expertise and a resort venue setting, contributing to the event held on Mactan Island in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu, Philippines.

faqs.question: Where does the marathon take place?
faqs.answer: The race is held on Mactan Island, located in Lapu-Lapu City, within Cebu province, Philippines. This coastal island setting serves as the venue for all four race distances offered at this event, from the 5km up to the full marathon.
